caption:
Most follow-up texts fail before the lead ever replies.

They fail one of three tests.

Run your last ten lead texts through this:

1. Speed: answer inside 5 minutes and close rates can double.
2. Specific: name the exact job, not a generic thank-you.
3. Stop: know the last message in the sequence before you send the first one.

Most shops only pass test one, if that.

The Lead Response Audit runs this test on your business for free.

DM TOOLS

#ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #SpeedToLead #SmallBusinessGrowth #CRMForContractors
rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 B2B saves/depth per current research, and this 3-S message-audit framework (speed, specific, stop) is a genuinely unclaimed angle distinct from every prior stage, ladder, cadence, decay-curve, and scorecard model already shipped.
